description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the EmployeeDependentService class within the OrangeHRM project. It validates functions such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee dependents by mocking the associated DAO class and asserting expected behaviors.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeDependentService, testing CRUD and search functionalities with mock dependencies.
